cpu_bookkeeping_probe.scope: TrainEngine.record_step with loss and step_time_seconds scalars; Python bookkeeping only, not process RSS or GPU memory

limits: Six real CLIP training steps validate rolling persistence, not a long-duration soak or quality threshold.
Direct seek resume requires zero workers, no CUDA prefetch, immutable uncompressed WDS shards and unchanged rank/batch identity.
Unknown, corrupt, linked or externally referenced checkpoints may be preserved beyond the configured retention count. One writer per checkpoint root is required.
The Windows symlink regression was skipped due to host permissions and passed on Linux. The other nine local skips are environment-dependent existing tests.

1/2/4-GPU corruption/recovery parity is recorded separately in ../long_run_fixes/summary.json against the v2 snapshot; this final snapshot additionally fixes sample caps, cache routing and symlink targets.
